en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large neo‑Gothic brick complex behind a line of leafy street trees. The central block has pointed arches, tall narrow windows, decorative gables with pinnacles and crosses, and an inner gateway passage through the middle of the building. In front stands a separate arched entrance gate in the same brick style, opening from a city street with iron railings on both sides. People are visible near the gate and at some open windows, and a flag flies from the roof.
